name: NEOC (New England Outdoor Camps)
description_short: Outdoor day camp at the Gardens at Elm Bank in Wellesley, with fields, woods, trails and Charles River access, for children from age 3 through entering 10th grade. Camp runs 9 to 4 with no technology; campers choose afternoon activities, and families can add busing, early drop off from 8 and extended day to 6.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund up to January 20 (or within 24 hours of registering); then NEOC credit of 100% to February 10, 75% to March 17, 50% to April 21 and 25% to May 19; nothing after May 19. The $100 per week deposit is refundable until January 20.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Ages & Dates page for summer 2027: age choices from 3 years (born September 2023 to August 2024) through entering 10th grade in September 2027; twelve weeks from the week of June 14 to the week of August 30, 2027. Week end dates are the Friday of each week (the July 6 week starts Tuesday). Session price is the current 2027 one week credit card rate from the rates page. age_max derived from entering grade 10.

Bus $112 a week by card ($109 ACH). Camp day 9 to 4. Prices rise as summer nears.
Researched by Claude from this page. Contact page: NEOC Campus, Elm Bank Reservation, 900 Washington Street, Wellesley, MA 02482; year round office One Hollis Street, Suite 423, Wellesley.

Researched by Claude from this page. FAQ: no lunch service at Elm Bank, campers pack a nut free lunch; a nut free snack is provided daily. Camp 9 to 4. Outdoor camp with indoor space for severe weather.

Researched by Claude from this page. About page: nature based outdoor camp, no technology, choice of afternoon sign up activities. Camp types (adventure, arts, general, junior, leadership, sports, STEAM) are from the site menu.
